messages:
Mira Patel: Short sync — need to finalize postmortem action owners + hard dates, decide exact wording for the status page blurb, and agree on RCA sharing policy for customers. Also propose a clear recurrence threshold for escalation.

Sam Ortiz: Action owners I have: TTL enforcement -> @Leah, autoscale gap -> infra (I'll ping infra leads). Need to lock dates.

Leah Chen: I can do TTL enforcement. Plan: add config guard, unit test, and a staging load run. Estimate 5 business days, target 2026-04-03.

Legal Bot: Quick note: any customer-facing RCA that includes per-request logs or customer-identifiable timestamps may require review. Recommend redacted summaries by default and expanded sanitized RCA only on request after Legal review.

Mira Patel: Good. Proposal for status page copy (short):

"Incident: Increased latency on hosted inference API
Status: Resolved
Summary: A deployment script unintentionally reset cache TTLs during a traffic surge, increasing compute and latency for a small percentage of requests (~4%). Mitigation: reverted the change and applied an emergency guard.
Next steps: enforce TTL defaults, update autoscaling, add rollout gating. A redacted RCA summary is available on the status page; full internal logs remain internal."

CS Bot: CS prefers proactive redacted summary on the status page to reduce inbound tickets. Also requests a canned email template for customers who ask for more detail (include impact window, percent affected, mitigation, ETA, contact).

Sam Ortiz: I'll add tasks and dates in the action tracker after Leah confirms. Also propose recurrence rule: if the same root-cause tag appears 3 times within 12 months, trigger a 30-day recurrence review + exec notification.

Leah Chen: Agrees with status copy. I'll draft a short technical blurb for the redacted RCA (no logs, just root cause, mitigation, and planned fixes) by 2026-03-28.

Mira Patel: OK final decisions: 1) Leah -> TTL enforcement by 2026-04-03, 2) Infra -> autoscale work by 2026-03-30, 3) Publish short status blurb + redacted RCA summary PDF once CS confirms percent and Legal signs off on redactions, 4) Recurrence threshold = 3-in-12 -> 30-day review and exec brief. Checkpoint meeting scheduled 2026-04-06.

ops-bot: Tasks created: "TTL enforcement (guard + tests)" -> Leah Chen -> due 1992758400; "Autoscale thresholds + canary" -> infra -> due 1992624000; "Draft redacted RCA PDF" -> Leah Chen -> due 1992556800.

Mira Patel: Thanks — I'll update tracker and loop in Legal once the redacted draft is ready.

Sam Ortiz: I'll prepare the CS email template and post it in this thread for review.
